payload.name: Ostensive-inferential social criticism
payload.fact: Social criticism on social media is frequently expressed through indirect forms like parody, irony, and sarcasm, which function as ostensive cues for audience inference.
payload.boundary: Indonesian digital discourse on Instagram and TikTok.

provenance.title: OSTENSIVE–INFERENTIAL COMMUNICATION AND DISCURSIVE POLITENESS IN SOCIAL MEDIA CRITIQUE: A STUDY OF INDONESIAN DIGITAL DISCOURSE
provenance.quote_or_locus: The findings reveal that social criticism is frequently expressed in indirect forms such as parody, irony, rhetorical questioning, sarcasm, empathetic narration, and symbolic comparison. These communicative resources function as ostensive cues that enable audience members to infer evaluative meanings
